an4.212:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.212:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 2.
an4.212:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.212:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhatam nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
